## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
CAUTION: Mixed internals despite broad sector participation. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive; Tech weak while Industrials, Energy and Healthcare lead — conflicting signals support CAUTION.

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Industrials lead: FDX (1W: +14.58% | 1M: +20.14%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +10.47% | 1M: +22.02%) ABOVE TREND.  
Energy strong: XOM (1W: +5.41% | 1M: +25.79%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +12.40% | 1M: +10.91%) ABOVE TREND.  
Consumer Staples resilience: PEP (1W: +10.97% | 1M: +24.44%) ABOVE TREND, WMT (1W: +10.11% | 1M: +16.38%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?  
Technology lagging: QCOM (1W: -9.40% | 1M: -23.78%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -6.77% | 1M: -17.03%) BELOW TREND.  
Consumer Discretionary soft: AMZN (1W: -12.11% | 1M: -12.93%) BELOW TREND, BKNG (1W: -10.89% | 1M: -18.15%) BELOW TREND.  
Real Estate showing relative underperformance vs leaders: Breadth context - Industrials/ Energy/Staples outperform; Tech drag remains dominant.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?  
Top 5: DOW (1W: +15.35% | 1M: +28.15%) ABOVE TREND, FDX (1W: +14.58% | 1M: +20.14%) ABOVE TREND, MMM (1W: +12.73% | 1M: +5.98%) ABOVE TREND, BMY (1W: +12.61% | 1M: +9.29%) ABOVE TREND, AMGN (1W: +12.41% | 1M: +12.49%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Concentrated (3/5 across Materials/Industrials/Healthcare).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?  
Bottom 5: QCOM (1W: -9.40% | 1M: -23.78%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -9.86% | 1M: -28.10%) BELOW TREND, BKNG (1W: -10.89% | 1M: -18.15%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -11.05% | 1M: -31.72%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -11.95% | 1M: -0.75%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Technology.

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Best 1W momentum: DOW (1W: +15.35% | 1M: +28.15%) ABOVE TREND, FDX (1W: +14.58% | 1M: +20.14%) ABOVE TREND, MMM (1W: +12.73% | 1M: +5.98%) ABOVE TREND; note MAJOR divergence among megacaps (CRM, GOOGL, META showing 1W/1M sign conflicts) — tactical risk, not a clean regime.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Tech under pressure with concentrated downside: AAPL (1W: +7.18% | 1M: +6.83%) ABOVE TREND is an outlier, while MSFT (1W: -6.77% | 1M: -17.03%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -2.99% | 1M: -1.96%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -9.86% | 1M: -28.10%) BELOW TREND and ORCL (1W: -13.22% | 1M: -25.74%) BELOW TREND drag; Tech breadth: ~6/19 positive (internal rotation, patchy).

8. Financials Outlook?  
Financials showing pockets of strength and short-term reversals: JPM (1W: +5.40% | 1M: -1.40%) RECOVERY, V (1W: +3.03% | 1M: -6.83%) RECOVERY, MA (1W: +1.85% | 1M: -5.23%) RECOVERY, PYPL (1W: -23.29% | 1M: -30.92%) BELOW TREND. Financials breadth: ~12/20 positive; style: Value/Cyclical tilt confirmed by Industrials/Energy leadership.

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Healthcare supportive and leading in parts: JNJ (1W: +5.61% | 1M: +15.66%) ABOVE TREND, BMY (1W: +12.61% | 1M: +9.29%) ABOVE TREND, AMGN (1W: +12.41% | 1M: +12.49%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: -3.58% | 1M: -19.04%) BELOW TREND. Healthcare breadth: ~11/15 positive; defensive component coexist with cyclical gains.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Favor cyclicals and select Financials and Energy exposures (CAT, XOM, JPM, FDX) while reducing exposure to the weakest large-cap Tech names (CRM, ORCL, QCOM) given trend breakdowns and headline-driven dispersion; style: Value/Cyclical over Growth for now.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: CAT (1W: +10.47% | 1M: +22.02%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +5.41% | 1M: +25.79%) ABOVE TREND, FDX (1W: +14.58% | 1M: +20.14%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: CRM (1W: -9.86% | 1M: -28.10%) BELOW TREND, QCOM (1W: -9.40% | 1M: -23.78%) BELOW TREND, AMZN (1W: -12.11% | 1M: -12.93%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Industrials (1W: +6.64% | 1M: +12.90%) — breadth strong.  
BEARISH: Technology (1W: -4.39% | 1M: -6.62%) — watch for continuation of rotation.  
WATCH: Consumer Discretionary (1W: -0.11% | 1M: +1.41%) for booking-related headlines.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
AAPL hold/confirm support near recent breakout area (AAPL (1W: +7.18% | 1M: +6.83%) ABOVE TREND) to validate strength; NVDA failure to reclaim near-term resistance (NVDA (1W: -2.99% | 1M: -1.96%) BELOW TREND) would extend tech pressure; JPM reclaiming short-term pivot (JPM (1W: +5.40% | 1M: -1.40%) RECOVERY) would support Financials continuation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?  
VLO (+55): VLO (1W: +12.40% | 1M: +10.91%) ABOVE TREND — earnings/dividend beat, price confirming sentiment.  
BA (+55): BA (1W: +3.98% | 1M: +6.54%) ABOVE TREND — geopolitical deal chatter confirming move.  
CRM (+60): CRM (1W: -9.86% | 1M: -28.10%) BELOW TREND — large AI/army deal headline but price diverging (distribution signal).  
AMD (+60): AMD (1W: -11.95% | 1M: -0.75%) BELOW TREND — bullish guidance headline but price not confirming.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
UNH (-60): UNH (1W: -3.58% | 1M: -19.04%) BELOW TREND — regulatory headlines align with price weakness.  
AMZN (-45): AMZN (1W: -12.11% | 1M: -12.93%) BELOW TREND — cautious outlook headlines confirming downside.  
LLY (-45): LLY (1W: +2.03% | 1M: -4.50%) RECOVERY — bearish commentary on pricing pressure but short-term price is divergent; monitor for follow-through.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION: Rotation toward Value/Cyclicals rather than a clean risk-off; Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive and Leadership: Concentrated (3/5 across Materials/Industrials/Healthcare).  
CAT (1W: +10.47% | 1M: +22.02%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +5.41% | 1M: +25.79%) ABOVE TREND and FDX (1W: +14.58% | 1M: +20.14%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength.  
Key risk is headline-driven divergence in Tech — CRM (1W: -9.86% | 1M: -28.10%) BELOW TREND and AMD (1W: -11.95% | 1M: -0.75%) BELOW TREND show bullish news yet falling prices, watch for distribution.
